author: Vusumuzi Mabasa
signal_rule: beta = architecture vector * selected scale * sqrt(800/n); two local-alternative strengths fixed by independent pilot
scope: Four Gaussian settings: n800 and1600, constant and age-varying dependence; one common focal SNP; prevalence .15 under null, MAF .25; no polygenic background, ancestry or real data
oracle: Known dependence: hold generating alpha fixed, estimate seven marginal nuisance parameters and exclude alpha from nuisance projection. All known: generating null nuisance parameters fixed, no nuisance projection, genotype centered at known 2MAF. Oracles diagnostic, not achievable or guaranteed power upper bounds.
intercept: Population null binary intercept fixed across alternatives, unlike v1; alternative prevalence can change
calibration: For each method/setting/alpha, floor(alpha*(5000+1))th order p; strict rejection. Freeze full calibration before any evaluation. Any calibration failure disables that cutoff.
failures: Never omit attempted datasets; all failures published; tests count failures as nonrejections; report valid and attempted denominators
uncertainty: Wilson intervals and paired MCSE conditional on frozen banks. 400 paired nonparametric bootstrap draws of calibration AND evaluation datasets give approximate intervals including calibration uncertainty; five disjoint 1000-null calibration subbanks diagnose smaller-bank variation. No exactly matched conditional size claim.
preservation: Original source, protocol, result cells, figures, original Word and software records retained. Complete v1 Git archive in baseline; new outputs under v2.
